findings.title: The locker plan does not say what its colours mean

location.description: The Science corridor locker card in the right half, the green, white dashed and blue tiles

findings.viewer_experience: The viewer sees green tiles, white tiles with a dashed edge and one blue tile, and has to guess which are taken, which are free and what blue means, since the card shows no key for them.

current.value: The tiles come in three looks with no key to say what each one means.

findings.target: A first-time viewer can say what each tile colour means without guessing.
findings.fix_direction: Add a short key or a label to the card for the tile colours.

closed_when.check: Look at the locker card: what each tile colour means is stated on the card.

findings.title: The three feature columns at the bottom read as plain text

location.description: The row of three short columns below the divider line

findings.viewer_experience: Three columns have the same heading and text style and nothing in them is concrete, so they read as filler and the eye passes over them.

current.value: Three columns of heading and two lines of grey text each.

findings.target: Each column gives the viewer a reason to read on.
findings.fix_direction: Make the strongest point of each column easier to take in.

closed_when.check: Look at the three columns: each one gives its main point at a glance.
